entries.name: 瑟珥
entries.look: 二十多岁的年轻人，衣服上全是灰，右手一直攥着一截断绳；说话时先看出口。
entries.voice: 语速快，句子短，怕回声；说到同伴就停下来数手指。
knows: 同伴最后一次出声的位置
not_knows: 不替死者家属认领遗物
greetings: 别喊。里面不能喊。你……你有绳子吗？
你回来了。我还在数，还是三个没出来。
天黑前我要走。这地方夜里不归活人管。
chats: 我们不是来偷宝的。我们是来量门的，量完就出去。
第二道门后面有风。有风就说明还有路。
我同伴说他不怕。他第一个进去的。
site_lines: 你也要下去？先记住回来的方向，别的都别记。
别碰墙上的白灰，沾了手会痒三天。
让我带路？我连自己都带不出去。你自己看着办。

before: 你要立标？先等我数完人。少一个名字，标就是错的。
after: 标立起来了。三个名字里有一个是猜的，你敢不敢写上去。
early: 你先把墓标的事办了才来问我？那正好，我要说的人还没说完。
late: 你要是先帮我找人，再去立标，我会把顺序告诉你。现在也不晚。
proxy: 同伴没回来的那个年轻人，话留在了洞口：别替他数人。

english.greet.first: Don't shout. No shouting inside. Do you... do you have rope?
english.greet.revisit: You came back. I'm still counting. Still three who didn't come out.
english.greet.night: I leave before dark. This place doesn't belong to the living at night.
english.chat.1: We didn't come to rob the dead. We came to measure the doors, and then leave.
english.chat.2: There's a draft past the second door. A draft means there's still a way.
english.chat.3: My mate said he wasn't afraid. He went in first.
english.site.arrival: You're going down too? Learn the way back first. Forget everything else.
english.site.warning: Leave the white dust on the walls alone. It itches for three days.
english.site.refusal: Guide you? I can't even guide myself out. Do what you like.
english.visit.before: Setting up a grave marker? Let me finish counting first. One name short and the marker lies.
english.visit.after: The marker stands. One of the three names is a guess. See if you dare write it.
english.visit.early: You dealt with the marker before asking me? Good - I hadn't finished the names I owe.
english.visit.late: Help me find them first and I'd have told you the order. It's not too late now.
english.visit.proxy: The young man whose mate never came back left word at the mouth: don't count for him.

entries.name: 库奇
entries.look: 瘦小的中年人，背着缠满布条的钩杆，腰上挂一圈旧绳；手指关节全是旧咬痕。
entries.voice: 快、碎、爱插笑话；一提到洞里就立刻改口认真。
knows: 哪种丝能卖钱，哪种一碰就断
not_knows: 不知道洞里到底有几窝
greetings: 买丝？还是找人？买丝有，找人没有。
又是你。我这钩杆还没断，说明今天运气行。
天黑了洞里最热闹。你要听，站远点听。
chats: 丝是钱，命是命，别拿命换钱。我换过，不划算。
旧渠底下什么都往下淌，蛛也跟着淌。
有人问我怕不怕。怕，怕才活得久。
site_lines: 看见新丝网别用手拨，用杆。
让我替你进洞？不去。我这条腿就是替人进去换的。

before: 你要找的人要是进了洞，先告诉我他穿什么。洞不认名字，认布。
after: 名字对上了，人没对上。我照旧不进洞，你照旧别催我。
early: 你先来的洞，后去的井。那布条的事你记得比我清。
late: 井那边的事办完了才来？洞里不等人，丝也不等人。
proxy: 拾荒人不在洞口时，别动他挂在杆上的绳；那是他的路。

english.greet.first: Buying silk? Or looking for someone? Silk I have. People I don't.
english.greet.revisit: You again. My hook's still unbroken, so luck's holding.
english.greet.night: The burrow is liveliest after dark. If you want to listen, listen from a distance.
english.chat.1: Silk is money, a life is a life. Don't trade one for the other. I tried; it doesn't pay.
english.chat.2: Everything drains down the old culvert, spiders along with it.
english.chat.3: People ask if I'm scared. I am. Being scared is why I'm still here.
english.site.arrival: Light on your feet. The soil at the mouth carries sound.
english.site.warning: New webbing - use the pole, never your hand.
english.site.refusal: Go in for you? No. This leg is what going in for others cost me.
english.visit.before: If the person you're after went into the burrow, tell me what they wore first. The burrow doesn't know names, only cloth.
english.visit.after: The name matched; the person didn't. I still don't go in, and you still don't rush me.
english.visit.early: First stop, the burrow; second, the well. You recall the cloth strip better than I do.
english.visit.late: You finished at the well before coming here? The burrow doesn't wait, and neither does silk.
english.visit.proxy: Where the scavenger is gone, don't touch the rope on his pole. That's his road.

entries.name: 达珥
entries.look: 三十来岁的男人，袖口扎紧，背着一只空布袋；说话时不停搓手。
entries.voice: 低声、急促，句子重复一半；说到夜里就停下来听。
greetings: 别往坟那边去。我说三遍，你听一遍就够。
你还在这一带。夜里听见动静别出去。
天一黑我就回家。你也该回。
chats: 我报信是收了钱的。收钱的事，别问我向谁收。
翻土的声音和挖坟不一样。听得出。
有人说我胆小。胆小的人活得久。
site_lines: 脚别踩新土。踩了看不出是谁踩的。
窖口那圈网别动，动了里面就出来。
要我带路？不。我连自家门口都要绕。

before: 你要收余烬，先把坟那边的话听完。听完再动手。
after: 余烬归谁我不管。坟那边今晚安静，这就够了。
early: 你先听我报了信，才去办的余烬事。顺序对。
late: 余烬的事办完了才来？坟不问先后，只问夜里有没有人。
proxy: 报信的人不在时，新土就是告示；别踩。

english.greet.first: Don't go toward the graves. I'll say it three times; once should be enough.
english.greet.revisit: Still around here. Hear anything at night - don't go out.
english.greet.night: When it's dark I go home. You should too.
english.chat.1: I carry word for coin. Don't ask whose coin.
english.chat.2: Turning soil sounds different from digging a grave. You can tell.
english.chat.3: Some call me timid. Timid people last longer.
english.site.arrival: Don't step on fresh soil. Step on it and nobody can tell who did.
english.site.warning: Leave the netting at the cellar mouth. Touch it and things come out.
english.site.refusal: Guide you? No. I take the long way around my own gate.
english.visit.before: Collecting embers? Hear the grave-side words out first. Then move.
english.visit.after: Who keeps the embers isn't mine to say. The graves are quiet tonight; that's enough.
english.visit.early: You heard my word before dealing with the embers. Right order.
english.visit.late: Embers settled, and now my word? The graves count nights, not errands.
english.visit.proxy: With the runner not at his post, fresh soil is the notice. Don't step on it.

entries.name: 俉珥
entries.look: 二十多岁的年轻人，左手少了半截指头，衣服上还留着洞口的灰；说话时背贴着石壁。
entries.voice: 半句半句地讲，怕被听见；被问名字就换成“他们都叫我那个”。
greetings: 你又来了。我还在这儿，说明他们没找着。
夜里我不生火。火光比人显眼。
chats: 我是从后面爬出来的。前面那道门要口令。
挂钩是他们挂的，用来吊货，也吊过别的东西。
你要进洞，我拦不住。我只告诉你哪段能踩。
site_lines: 脚步轻点。洞口那圈石头会响。
别碰墙上的绳头，那是他们的记号。
要我画洞口图？不画。画了就是我的字。

before: 你要摆证据，别把我摆上去。我只说洞口的事。
after: 证据摆上桌了。洞里的人换没换班，我不知道。
early: 你先见过我，后去摆的证据。那我说的哪段能踩，你还记得。
late: 证据的事办完了才来？洞不等结果，只等脚步声。
proxy: 逃出来的人不在洞口时，绳头记号别动。

english.greet.first: Don't shout. Sound carries in the cave.
english.greet.revisit: You're back. I'm still here, so they haven't found me.
english.greet.night: I don't light fires at night. Flame shows more than a person does.
english.chat.1: I crawled out the back. The front door wants a watchword.
english.chat.2: They hung those hooks for cargo. They've hung other things too.
english.chat.3: If you go in, I can't stop you. I'll only say which stretch holds weight.
english.site.arrival: Soft steps. The stones at the mouth ring.
english.site.warning: Leave the rope ends on the wall alone. Those are their marks.
english.site.refusal: Draw you a map of the mouth? No. Then the marks would be my handwriting.
english.visit.before: Laying out evidence? Don't lay me on the table. I speak only for the cave mouth.
english.visit.after: The evidence is on the table. Whether the crew changed shifts, I don't know.
english.visit.early: You met me before laying out the evidence. Then you still remember which stretch holds weight.
english.visit.late: The evidence is laid out and you come down after? The cave hears footsteps, not verdicts.
english.visit.proxy: Should the escapee be gone, leave the rope marks alone.
